title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00110 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: C/o elevator inserts to 4. 5in inserts. L/d perforation guns BHA, inspected BHA, all shots fired. C/o elevator inserts back to 5. 5in inserts
00:30 - 00:45: P/u EZSV setting tool
00:45 - 03:00: RIH w/ EZSV setting tool to 163m, installed ps21, continued RIH to 820m
03:00 - 04:30: Broke and m/u 1x double and 2x 3m pups for spaceout pump-in sub. M/u pump-in sub, cementing hose w/ ltvs. Recorded up/down weights 97t/91t. RIH and stang into EZSV w/ running tool w/ 10t set down weight.
04:30 - 04:45: Performed pre-job meeting for displacement annulus behind 13 3/8in CSG,
04:45 - 07:00: Circulated annulus behind 13 3/8in CSG to clean sea water, increased flow rate from 250 to 1250lpm, pumped 2 bu or total of 144 m3, until clear sea water confirmed in returns. Observed h2s of MAX 14ppm on baker sensor in gas trap. No h2s in air measured on gas sensor in shaker room. Treated returns with sourscav to remove h2s and soda ash increase ph) to prevent forming new h2s
07:00 - 07:45: Flow checked well on full opened choke static. Opened UPR and continued monitoring well on trip tank. Static. Meanwhile performed TBT for cement job
07:45 - 08:15: Performed line test prior to cement job to 100 bar. Good test. Checked line up, prepared for pumping cement job
08:15 - 10:00: Cement plug in annulus between 13 3/8in CSG and 20in CSG. Theoretical height from 850m to 450m Pumped 20 m3 of wash pill, 1200 l/min/ 13 bar. Mixed and pumped 35 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with cement unit with 11 m3 of drill water, 1200 l/min, pumping pressure went up to 50 bar.
10:00 - 10:30: Stang out of EZSV w/ running tool, p/u 3. 5m above EZSV. Balanced cement plug. Theoretical height from 840m to 740m Mixed and pumped 7,7 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with cement unit with 7,8 m3 of drill water, 800 l/min, pumping pressure of 10 bar.
10:30 - 11:00: Broke off cement hose and checked for backflow no backflow observed, string

sections.text: C/o elevator inserts to 4. 5in inserts. L/d perforation guns BHA, inspected BHA, all shots fired. C/o elevator inserts back to 5. 5in inserts
RIH w/ EZSV setting tool to 163m, installed ps21, continued RIH to 820m

Broke and m/u 1x double and 2x 3m pups for spaceout pump-in sub. M/u pump-in sub, cementing hose w/ ltvs. Recorded up/down weights 97t/91t. RIH and stang into EZSV w/ running tool w/ 10t set down weight.
Performed pre-job meeting for displacement annulus behind 13 3/8in CSG,

Circulated annulus behind 13 3/8in CSG to clean sea water, increased flow rate from 250 to 1250lpm, pumped 2 bu or total of 144 m3, until clear sea water confirmed in returns. Observed h2s of MAX 14ppm on baker sensor in gas trap. No h2s in air measured on gas sensor in shaker room. Treated returns with sourscav to remove h2s and soda ash increase ph) to prevent forming new h2s
Flow checked well on full opened choke static. Opened UPR and continued monitoring well on trip tank. Static. Meanwhile performed TBT for cement job
Performed line test prior to cement job to 100 bar. Good test. Checked line up, prepared for pumping cement job

Cement plug in annulus between 13 3/8in CSG and 20in CSG. Theoretical height from 850m to 450m Pumped 20 m3 of wash pill, 1200 l/min/ 13 bar. Mixed and pumped 35 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with cement unit with 11 m3 of drill water, 1200 l/min, pumping pressure went up to 50 bar.

Stang out of EZSV w/ running tool, p/u 3. 5m above EZSV. Balanced cement plug. Theoretical height from 840m to 740m Mixed and pumped 7,7 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with cement unit with 7,8 m3 of drill water, 800 l/min, pumping pressure of 10 bar.
Broke off cement hose and checked for backflow no backflow observed, string on vacuum. L/d cement assembly. POOH from 836. 5m to 730m 2 min

P/u single with 2 x sponge balls installed and m/u TDS. Circulated at 2500 l/min, 19 bar, 50 RPM, 2-4knm until clean returns confirmed. Totally pumped 3x bottoms up Meanwhile flushed manifolds after cement job
POOH from 730m to 85m. Removed ps21 slips and installed master busing. Continued POOH to surface. L/d EZSV running tool
Cleaned rig floor after cement job, broke out cement assembly and l/d same
M/u BOP jetting sub and washed/jet BOP with 1500 LPM at 3 bar. Broke off jetting sub and r/b stand
WOC. Meanwhile carried out maintenance on aft and FWD PRS, DW, TDS, aft IR.
WOC. Meanwhile worked to install CSG tongs on fox hole side. Continued maintenance TDS, housekeeping in shakers, prepared tools and equipment for n/d diverter and BOP. Refilled gearbox oil on TDS
